scenario_name: Beijing earthquake rescue planning with OSM regional road network
historical_event_name: 1679 Sanhe-Pinggu earthquake Beijing impact zone with OSM regional road network
road_data_source: OpenStreetMap / Overpass API regional highway extract
description: The routing graph uses a continuous OSM regional road network between Tsinghua University and Beijing Chaoyang Railway Station. Historical earthquake impact is mapped to road segments by buffer overlay before Dijkstra route planning.
